Class TrackingStop

java.lang.Object
frc.spectrumLib.mechanism.TrackingStop
public final class TrackingStop extends Object
Latches a mechanism to a stop once it has stayed out of tolerance of its closed-loop goal for a debounce time: a jam, a slipped belt, a motor fighting a hard stop. The pattern is 6328's 2025 elevator, which stopped itself the same way rather than pushing into whatever held it.

Pure logic on values the caller reads from logged inputs, so it replays. The caller holds the motor in neutral while isStopped().

    • TrackingStop

      public TrackingStop(double tolerance, double debounceSeconds)
      Parameters:
      tolerance - largest error that counts as tracking, in the units of the error passed to update(double, boolean, boolean, boolean, double, boolean)
      debounceSeconds - how long the error must stay out before it is a fault

  • Method Details

    • update

      public boolean update(double nowSeconds, boolean enabled, boolean connected, boolean closedLoop, double error, boolean act)
      Advances one loop.
      Parameters:
      nowSeconds - the robot clock
      enabled - the robot is enabled; disabling clears the stop
      connected - the motor answered this loop. A disconnected motor's readings are stale or zero, so they restart the debounce instead of counting toward it.
      closedLoop - the motor ran a closed-loop setpoint since the last loop
      error - measured minus goal
      act - latch the stop on a fault; false only reports the fault
      Returns:
      true on the loop the stop latches
